_about: Music rules for Safe House Church shorts. Pastor Matthew's direction (Nov 13, 2026): Bible study clips get CCM / gospel worship instrumentals (CeCe Winans instrumental feel). Preaching clips: leave some with no music; when music is used it must be majestic, with a strong worship build-up. Never sad, somber, or synthesized music.

rules.bible_study: Every Bible study short gets music, using the bible_study list.
rules.preaching: Of the two Sunday shorts each week, make one VOICE ONLY (the most intense, preached-up moment usually works best bare) and give the other music from the preaching_majestic list. Start the track so its build-up lands under his strongest line.
rules.volume: Keep his voice clearly on top. For baked-in tracks use music_volume 12-16. For Instagram audio use audioVolume 15-20 and videoVolume 100.
rules.variety: Never use the same track twice in one week, and try not to repeat a track two weeks in a row.

files._about: Real track files Pastor Matthew has approved. They are baked into the video for every platform (TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram). Each entry needs: title, url (hosted under https://safehousechurch.org/media/music/), list (bible_study or preaching_majestic), source/license. Empty until he sends tracks.

instagram_audio._about: Instagram's licensed music library, added at posting time through Metricool (instagramData.audioConfiguration.audioId). Instagram Reels only. Use it when the short has no baked-in track. A short that already has a baked-in track does not also get Instagram audio. Picked from catalog search; Pastor Matthew can remove any he doesn't like.
